#!/bin/bash

# Exit immediately if a command exits with a non-zero status
set -e

# Default archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="release.tar.gz"

# Allow overriding the archive name via command line argument
if [ -n "$1" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_NAME="$1"
fi

# Ensure the archive name ends with .tar.gz or .tgz
if [[ ! "$ARCHIVE_NAME" =~ \.(tar\.gz|tgz)$ ]]; then
    ARCHIVE_NAME="${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
fi

# Pre-deployment validation step
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."

ENV_FILE=".env.test"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: Required validation file '${ENV_FILE}' not found!" >&2
    exit 1
fi

validation_failed=0

# Read .env.test line by line to confirm all keys have a value
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    # Trim leading/trailing whitespace
    line=$(echo "$line" | xargs)
    
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$line" ]] || [[ "$line" =~ ^# ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if the line matches KEY=VALUE pattern
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^([^=]+)=(.*)$ ]]; then
        key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        val="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        
        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        val=$(echo "$val" | xargs)
        
        # Check if the key has a value
        if [ -z "$val" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '${key}' is empty or not set in ${ENV_FILE}" >&2
            validation_failed=1
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: Line does not match KEY=VALUE format: $line" >&2
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

if [ "$validation_failed" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Validation failed! Please ensure all environment variables in ${ENV_FILE} have values." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Validation passed: All environment variables in ${ENV_FILE} have values."

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}..."

# Create a temporary file for the archive to avoid "file changed as we read it" errors
TEMP_ARCHIVE=$(mktemp /tmp/release.XXXXXX.tar.gz)

# Ensure the temporary file is cleaned up on exit
trap 'rm -f "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"' EXIT

# Create the tar.gz archive, excluding node_modules, .git, and any existing archive file
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude="${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    -czf "$TEMP_ARCHIVE" .

# Move the completed archive to the destination
mv "$TEMP_ARCHIVE" "$ARCHIVE_NAME"

echo "Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
